snapshots.note: First lab-confirmed case (British male, medevac from Ascension Island to South Africa). One Dutch passenger had already died on April 11; cause not yet linked at this point.
WHO update: seven cases total, two laboratory confirmed and five suspected, three deaths. Ship anchored off Praia, Cape Verde; Cape Verde declined to permit docking.
Andes virus (ANDV) confirmed by reference lab. Three medical evacuees airlifted to the Netherlands (one British, one Dutch crew, one German). Swiss passenger tests positive after returning home.
WHO updates total to 8 cases — 5 confirmed, 3 suspected, 3 deaths. Remaining people on board reported asymptomatic; ship sailing toward Tenerife with planned arrival May 9 at the port of Granadilla.

Counts unchanged from the WHO May 7 update. Spain's latest operational plan is for MV Hondius to reach Tenerife waters without docking; passengers will be evaluated on board and transferred for repatriation without contact with the local public.
